title: Connectivity Is Invariant Under Relabeling
statement: Let $v$ be a natural number, and encode a simple graph on the vertex set $\{0,\ldots,v-1\}$ by a Boolean function on its two-element vertex subsets. The Boolean property that every pair of vertices is joined by a path is invariant under every permutation of the vertices.
hypotheses_covered: The graph is encoded by a Boolean function on the two-element subsets of its vertex set
Invariance is required under every vertex permutation
